{{Quote|This is Galactic Alliance Ship ''Rinkin Four'', inbound to Corellia. We have an emergency. Please reply. Over|Rinkin IV's navigator|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''''Rinkin IV''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that served in the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy's]] support-and-supply division.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]], <ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> it was traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] when it was pulled out two hours away from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] into normal space without its escorts. The ship was then assaulted within by unknown individuals by incapacitating its crew with a [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]].<ref name="MK" />
